si3_author_journal_year: Boyang Mao et al., Developmental Cognitive Neuroscience, 2025
si4_title: Mapping early corpus callosum development to identify neurodevelopmental risk

dc1_datasets_using.detail: Data were collected from Zhejiang Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University. Two cohorts were used: Dataset 1 (295 TDC) and Dataset 2 (41 TDC, 26 ASD).
dc1_datasets_using.supporting_text: This study utilized two brain imaging datasets collected at Zhejiang Children ' s Hospital, Zhejiang University.

answer.Dataset 1: normative training for sex-specific growth curve models

answer.Dataset 2: clinical validation and generalizability testing (test set for ASD identification)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Dataset 1 was used to construct growth curve models. Dataset 2 was used to validate the models' ability to identify ASD in an independent sample across different scanner strengths.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Dataset 1 ... was used to construct growth curve models of the corpus callosum. Dataset 2 ... was used to assess the capability of the growth curve models to identify ASD based on deviations in corpus callosum morphology.

model-1.model-name: Sex-specific growth curve models for corpus callosum morphometrics

dc3_hc_n.detail: Train phase (Dataset 1) includes 295 typically developing children (TDC). Overall phase includes Dataset 1 (295) and Dataset 2 TDC (41), totaling 336 healthy controls.
dc3_hc_n.supporting_text: Dataset 1 (n = 295, TDC) was used to construct growth curve models... Dataset 2 (n = 41, TDC; n = 26, ASD) was used to validate the classifier
dc3_hc_n.location: study_1/Mao2025.pdf.md: 2. Methods / 2.1. Datasets; 2.3. Overview of the datasets and analyses

dc4_age_info.detail: Weighted mean calculated from Age Group counts in Table 1 using midpoints (1.5 to 6.5). Min/Max based on Age Group labels (Group 1: 1-2, Group 6: 6-7).
dc4_age_info.supporting_text: Dataset 1 consists of structural brain images from 295 typically developing children (TDC), aged 1 -6 years... Age Group 6: 6-7 years

dc5_sex_info.detail: Train-phase (Dataset 1): 138 female (46.8%), 157 male (53.2%). Overall-phase includes Dataset 2 TDC (28 female, 13 male), leading to 166 female and 170 male controls.
